name: hyperlocal-marketplace
description: Hyperlocal secondhand marketplace with role-based access, geofenced listings, chat, reviews, and AI fraud scoring.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && cd ml_service && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
scripts.install:ml: cd ml_service && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
